About

Deep Roots, Worn Everywhere

For those that live between worlds.

Zephyr Archive was founded by two brothers, Chris and Paddy DeBruyne, for the people that aren’t defined by one world, but for those that live between them. Bred and brought up with roots in New England, we carried that culture throughout our lives no matter where we were.

Deep Roots, Worn Everywhere goes beyond just clothing. It’s for those that carry their culture, values and beliefs no matter where they are. Every piece is built with that person in mind. Substantial enough to last, understated enough to go anywhere.

  • Fenway on a summer night.
  • A dawn session on the California coast.
  • Fresh snow in the Uintas.
  • A night out in the city.

Zephyr Archive isn’t made for one place. It’s made for all of them. Deep roots, worn everywhere.

— Chris & Paddy DeBruyne
